note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 26 November 2026, RealHunt lists 14 homes for sale in Mexico, each one checked by a person.
In Mexico, the median asking price of those 14 homes is €97,100 (€1,266 per m², from the 14 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €50,575 and the most expensive €216,600.
Taxes and fees add about 3.5–8% to the price of a home in Mexico (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Acquisition tax 2-5% + notary 0.5-1% + legal 1-1.5% (GPG 3.5-7.5%), plus 0.5-1.5% for fideicomiso/permit setup; TheLatinvestor budgets 5-8%.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes, but in the Restricted Zone (within 50 km of the coast or 100 km of borders, which covers Tulum and Playa del Carmen) only through a fideicomiso bank trust or a Mexican company; direct ownership elsewhere.
buying.annual_property_tax: Municipal predial, set locally on cadastral value; usually small, often less than HOA fees.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents: 25% ISR withholding on gross rent; plus 16% IVA on short-term stays (Airbnb remits on its bookings).

homes.title: Five-bed stone and brick house with a Lake Chapala view terrace in El Tepehuaje
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra y ladrillo de cinco dormitorios con terraza con vistas al Lago Chapala en El Tepehuaje
homes.summary: Asking MX$4,080,000 (about €195,300). An 8-year-old house of 245 m² on a 514 m² plot in the village of El Tepehuaje, on the south shore of Lake Chapala and about an hour from Guadalajara. It has arched windows, stone walls and brick vaulted ceilings, a living and dining room with a double-sided fireplace and a kitchen with a breakfast bar. There are five bedrooms, each with its own full bathroom; the main one has a lake view, a sitting area and a jacuzzi. A large roof terrace looks over the lake, and there is a patio with a fire pit, a barbecue area and parking for two cars.

Delfines in Mazatlán's Alarcón area: living and dining room, two bedrooms with wardrobes, a bathroom, laundry, terrace and parking. homes.title: Colonial house with a pool and garden in Barrio de Santiago, Mérida centre
homes.title_es: Casa colonial con piscina y jardín en Barrio de Santiago, centro de Mérida
homes.summary: Asking MX$4,450,000 (about €216,600) for Casa Ya'axche', a single-storey colonial house of 160 m² on a 279 m² plot in Barrio de Santiago, one of the old neighbourhoods of central Mérida. It keeps its stone walls, high ceilings and patterned cement tile floors. The living room, kitchen and dining area open onto a long swimming pool, and there are inner gardens with mature trees, a barbecue area and terrace. Both bedrooms have their own bathroom, air conditioning and fans, and there is a third bathroom by the patio, a covered parking space and a laundry room. The photos show it renovated and furnished.

homes.title: Three-bedroom house in a gated estate with pool and tennis in El Marqués, Querétaro
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios en una urbanización cerrada con piscina y tenis en El Marqués, Querétaro
homes.summary: Asking MX$3,125,000 (about €152,100) for a three-year-old two-storey house of about 146 m² in Alleza Mirador, a gated estate in El Marqués on the edge of Querétaro city. It has three bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a guest toilet, an open kitchen with island and stainless appliances, a laundry room, fitted wardrobes and a covered back terrace with skylights. Two cars park in front. The advert describes it as in excellent condition, and the photos show a tidy, modern home. Residents share a swimming pool, gym, tennis and padel courts, play area and barbecue spots. Maintenance fee not stated.

homes.title: Three-bedroom house in a gated complex with a pool in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios en un complejo amurallado con piscina en Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco
homes.summary: Asking MX$3,250,000 (about €160,200), and the advert says the price is negotiable, for a two-storey house of about 94 m² in the Rosales complex in Parques Universidad, Puerto Vallarta. It has three bedrooms, one on the ground floor, two full bathrooms, a living and dining room, kitchen, service patio, front garden and parking for one car. Four air conditioning units and window bars are included, and it can be sold furnished. The walled complex has a swimming pool, terrace and gardens, which one bedroom balcony overlooks. The photos show a clean, bright home ready to use. Maintenance fee not stated.

homes.title: Three-bedroom house in a gated community with a pool in Mazatlán, Sinaloa
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios en una comunidad privada con piscina en Mazatlán, Sinaloa
homes.summary: Asking MX$2,900,000 (about €143,000) for a two-storey house of about 75 m² in Coto San Julio, a gated cluster in the Hacienda del Seminario area of Mazatlán, listed as about ten years old. It has three bedrooms with wardrobes, two bathrooms, a living room, dining area, a remodelled kitchen, a patio and one parking space. Split air conditioning and ceiling fans are fitted. Residents share a swimming pool and the entrance has security around the clock. The photos show a tidy, furnished home that looks ready to move into. Mazatlán is a Pacific beach city. Maintenance fee not stated.
